personnage: the Mesopotamian countryball (a clay-colored terracotta ball with a long neatly braided black beard)

scenes.sujet: the Egyptian countryball (golden skin, blue and gold striped nemes headdress) looking very surprised with wide-open eyes and raised eyebrows, pyramids in the background, while the large shadow of {perso} looms over it from the side

scenes.debut: Il y a plus de cinq mille ans
scenes.sujet: {perso} standing proudly on fertile land between two winding bright blue rivers, at sunrise, the sun rising behind it, palm trees and reeds along the rivers

a vast fertile valley seen from a low hill: two winding blue rivers (the Tigris and the Euphrates) run side by side across a golden plain; a white and blue Greek countryball with a golden laurel wreath stands on the hill and points at the land with a white cartoon glove

a landscape that transforms from one side to the other: a dry cracked arid plain where {perso} digs a canal with a wooden hoe, then straight irrigation canals full of blue water and lush golden wheat fields swaying under the sun

the city of Uruk seen from a distance: thick mud-brick walls with gates, flat-roofed houses, a temple on a terrace, and many tiny clay-colored countryball inhabitants walking around, warm afternoon light
extreme close-up of a white cartoon glove holding a sharpened reed stylus and pressing wedge-shaped cuneiform marks into a soft wet clay tablet, small clay crumbs, warm golden light

scenes.debut: Ils sont aussi parmi les premiers
scenes.sujet: an ancient solid wooden wheel made of three planks held together with wooden crossbars, with a small axle hole in the center

scenes.debut: et ils comptent en base soixante
scenes.sujet: a round golden clock whose dial shows only the number 60 at the top, surrounded by a thin graduated circle with 360 small tick marks like a protractor

a huge stepped ziggurat with several terraced levels and a long central staircase, a small temple at the top, at sunset with an orange and red sky; {perso} stands at the foot of the ziggurat, looking up at it
Gilgamesh as a heroic countryball: clay-colored skin, a golden royal crown, a long curly braided black beard, determined frowning eyes, facing a big roaring cartoon lion, epic warm lighting

an army of Akkadian countryballs with bronze helmets and spears, led by King Sargon (a bigger countryball with a tall golden crown and a braided beard), marching toward a Sumerian mud-brick city, dramatic red sky

a recap composition: a cuneiform clay tablet, a wooden wheel, a stepped ziggurat and a round clock float in the upper half of the image in a soft golden gradient, glowing; {perso} appears small at the bottom center, looking up at them with a half-moon smile
